title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week's spotlight is Michael Patrick Kelly's "Beautiful Madness" — a warm, sun-soaked reggae-tinged pop song with a gently uplifting groove and a feel-good chorus that rolls like a smile catching on. It brings a bright, holiday-away-from-it-all warmth into a Djembe set, an easy mid-show lift that people hum along to.
songListNote: Song of the Week — Michael Patrick Kelly's sunlit reggae-pop "Beautiful Madness" joins the request catalog this week.
